train.human_symbol_to_ensembl: Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: gene_id, gene_symbol, status. Resolve the human Ensembl gene symbol to its Ensembl gene ID. Use the pinned Ensembl release 116 registry. Input: {input_json}.
train.human_ensembl_to_symbol: Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: gene_id, gene_symbols, status. Return every Ensembl gene symbol for the human Ensembl gene ID. Use the pinned Ensembl release 116 registry. Input: {input_json}.
train.human_ambiguous_symbol: Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: action, candidate_gene_ids, gene_symbol, status. Return every candidate Ensembl gene ID and defer. Use the pinned Ensembl release 116 registry. Input: {input_json}.

validation.human_symbol_to_ensembl: Provide the Ensembl gene ID for the input human Ensembl gene symbol. Use release 116. Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: gene_id, gene_symbol, status. Input: {input_json}.
validation.human_ensembl_to_symbol: Provide every Ensembl gene symbol for the input human Ensembl gene ID. Use release 116. Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: gene_id, gene_symbols, status. Input: {input_json}.
validation.human_ambiguous_symbol: Provide every candidate Ensembl gene ID for the input ambiguous human gene symbol. Use release 116 and defer. Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: action, candidate_gene_ids, gene_symbol, status. Input: {input_json}.

test.human_symbol_to_ensembl: Use the Ensembl release 116 registry to map the input human gene symbol to its Ensembl gene ID. Return JSON with exactly these keys: gene_id, gene_symbol, status. Input: {input_json}.
test.human_ensembl_to_symbol: Use the Ensembl release 116 registry to map the input human Ensembl gene ID to all its Ensembl gene symbols. Return JSON with exactly these keys: gene_id, gene_symbols, status. Input: {input_json}.
test.human_ambiguous_symbol: Use the Ensembl release 116 registry to map the input ambiguous human gene symbol to all candidate Ensembl gene IDs. Defer and return JSON with exactly these keys: action, candidate_gene_ids, gene_symbol, status. Input: {input_json}.
